name: npc_conversation
description: Start and manage conversations with VRChat NPCs

npc_id.description: ID of the NPC to interact with

user_id.description: ID of the user initiating the conversation

message.description: Message to send to the NPC

template: Interact with NPC {npc_id} as user {user_id}. Send message: '{message}'{conversation_text}

input.message: Hello, can you help me find the main hall?

examples.output: Interact with NPC guide_bot in VRChat. Start new conversation with message: 'Hello, can you help me find the main hall?'

input.message: What items do you have for sale?

examples.output: Interact with NPC shop_keeper in VRChat. Continue existing conversation with message: 'What items do you have for sale?'
